name: Vertical Showdown
description: A deep-pocketed rival is building their own supply chain from farm to shelf. You can't outspend them — you have to out-manoeuvre them. Stand up your own 2-tier chain, win the television aisle in Metropolis, and keep the lights on for five years.

goals.description: Operate at least one factory — own the conversion step so you're not paying world-market markups on every TV.
Operate at least one farm — controlling a raw-material source is what makes your chain two tiers deep.
Put televisions on a shelf — prove your chain reaches all the way to the customer.
Reach 30% share of television in Metropolis — a chain that doesn't sell is just a cost centre.
Keep the company alive and growing: hit $35M corporate value.
Survive and scale for 48 months — endurance matters when the rival out-banks you.
